explainer_content.short_definition: Chicago club foundations: soulful repetition, machines, DJs, and dancers building the track together.
explainer_content.history_capsule: House emerged from Chicago dance spaces where DJs, drum machines, disco memory, queer nightlife, and Black/Latino club culture made a new electronic pulse.
explainer_content.why_it_mattered: It rewired global pop and club music around the producer/DJ and the repeating groove.
explainer_content.what_made_it_distinct: Unlike techno's colder futurism, house keeps a warmer relationship to disco, soul, vocals, and communal release.
